levels.2: passing isolated unit or differential tests
levels.4: verified against the original DOS executable in a stated domain (three-way, scenario level)

notes: Levels are the highest level reached inside the stated domain; a subsystem can be level 2 for isolated routines and still level 5 at scenario level. Both are given.

Verification is tape-free (portable/tests/acceptance/run.py, about 4 minutes): the DOSBox-X recorder and the port run the same ideal-machine clock rule (native-clock-v1, portable/whole_program/platform/README.md; device interrupts only at the game's charged clock reads), scenarios are tick scripts, and a constant per-executable profile (load paragraph, INT09 DGROUP) is the only machine input. DOS references are recorded once per executable (build/reference/sound-off-identity, sound-on-identity-v1). Native runs unpaced and is compared per simulation step in game state (1,032 views), at checkpoint frames (indexed pixels, attributes, DAC, software cursor) and in raw audio commands.

Two documented observer rules apply in every variant: keyboard-context-v1 (Event.h/v of queued keyboard IRQ events, evidence/canonical/native-input-irq/normal-words.md) and animation identity (yard ID holders by identity pattern, evidence/canonical/native-ideal-clock/animation-identity.md). Raw values stay as diagnostics.
Audio is verified separately by the playback check: song, note and sample events with game time, descriptor and emitted PCM bytes, exact apart from a 1 ns bound on sample timestamps.

Retired: per-site clock tapes, service-order replay, ISR schedules and sound-call boundaries, device-answer replay, per-event register replay (moved to to_delete/ with their references; history in evidence/canonical/native-ideal-clock/tape-retirement.md).

scenarios.gameplay sound on (Sound Blaster mode 6): all 18 lanes equal: 26,128 entries in game state, 152 frames, raw audio commands exact
scenarios.audio playback (11 scenarios incl. audio: all 22 lanes equal: 28,176 entries; 8 MIDI identities, 23 effects, 18 sample identities observed on both sides; shipped samples never loop (synthetic wrap test only)
scenarios.corpus: new-game-save, quick-game, long-run, interactive-play, ant-commands, load-from-save (original A.ANT), full-game, experiment, random-17 (seeded); tutorial not covered

finish_line: Port verified faithful for normal play when every corpus scenario is equal to both DOS executables in game state for its whole step count, checkpoint frames are equal, and audio playback is equal, with sound on and off, by the tape-free upper-layer regression (portable/tests/acceptance/run.py, a few minutes with cached references). Met for the current nine-scenario corpus; a tutorial scenario and further modes extend it.
